proposed_boundary.role: Conservative local necessary-gate boundary derived from the pinned reference reader. Not an organiser rule, replacement matrix target or claim of parity with every published contender.
proposed_boundary.dataset_scope: Both cleaned S500 and M500, same configuration. QA target remains1.0 every repeat; no subsets or abstention exclusions.
proposed_boundary.reader: gpt-4o-2024-08-06 for every generative system call; temperature0
proposed_boundary.judge: gpt-4o-2024-08-06 native evaluator; separate audited source-aware procedure still requires completion and freeze.
proposed_boundary.derivation: Reference128000 context minus800 generation leaves127200 input; the historical126200 history cap leaves1000 for metadata/instructions. Extending these limits over all calls is an explicit conservative proposal, not an upstream rule.
proposed_boundary.counted_tokens: All complete prompts, source repeats, intermediate notes, tool envelopes and completions count; cached/prefix tokens still count physically. No free ingestion or subcalls and no omitted preparation costs. No cross-question or future-user amortization in this local gate.
proposed_boundary.call_count: Not fixed to one. Any positive number of calls must fit the same aggregate token and per-call window limits.
proposed_boundary.comparison: Candidate and reference/comparator receive identical sources and the same allowed models and envelope. A published higher score with different models/cost remains an unresolved global comparison, not a defeated or discarded competitor.
proposed_boundary.cost_meaning: Componentwise token limits imply no larger decoder-token bill at identical positive frozen prices without cache discounts. Dollar prices, memory-system CPU/GPU/storage cost and latency are not established by this bound; record them separately and freeze matched limits before a full comparison.
proposed_boundary.metadata: Preserve physical occurrence, observation date and role; strip answers, answer_session_ids, has_answer, task-type and answer-bearing IDs from system inputs.
proposed_boundary.no_budget_rescue: Freeze this proposal or an independently justified alternative before counter results. A failed M budget cannot be enlarged post hoc to pass the same card.
